critical_path.description: The mapping of raw counts to daily cohorts is required before any rate computation can be performed. Without it, the engine cannot validate recomputability.

critical_path.to_workstream: Delta Calculation and Anomaly Threshold Definition
critical_path.description: Deltas are derived from weekly totals only after rates are computed. This step is non-negotiable for anomaly detection.

critical_path.from_workstream: Delta Calculation and Anomaly Threshold Definition
critical_path.description: The parser must validate that all deltas are signed percentages derived from weekly totals before it can accept input. This is a hard dependency on rate computation.

critical_path.to_workstream: Data Reconciliation Between Legacy and New Pipeline
critical_path.description: Reconciliation requires the parser to produce valid, compliant output before legacy data can be matched. Without this, decommissioning cannot proceed.

decision_log.title: Rate Format Specification
decision_log.decision: All rates are computed as decimals to four places (e.g., 0.8600), derived from summed numerators of raw daily counts, not from averaging daily rates.
decision_log.basis: Binding constraint: 'Rates are decimals to four places; deltas are signed percentages computed from summed numerators'
decision_log.source_material: Latest weekly extract: onboarding rates near 0.86

decision_log.title: Delta Calculation Methodology
decision_log.decision: Deltas are computed as signed percentages using weekly totals, not from daily averages or per-day rate differences.
decision_log.basis: Binding constraint: 'deltas are signed percentages computed from summed numerators'
decision_log.source_material: Latest weekly extract: prior-week totals for deltas

decision_log.title: Anomaly Definition and Reporting
decision_log.decision: Any deviation beyond 1.5 percentage points from the weekly mean is classified as an anomaly; if no cause is known, it must be labeled 'none-known'.
decision_log.basis: Binding constraint: 'Anomalies are deviations beyond 1.5 percentage points from the weekly mean'

decision_log.title: Parser Hard-Fail Rules
decision_log.decision: The dashboard parser must hard-fail on missing keys, percentage-versus-decimal confusion, and silent zero-fills for unmeasured cells.
decision_log.basis: Background: 'dashboard parser hard-fails on missing keys, percentage-versus-decimal confusion, and silent zero-fills'

decision_log.title: Unit Labeling Requirement
decision_log.decision: Every numeric column must carry its unit in its label (e.g., 'onboarding_rate' → 'onboarding_rate [unitless]'), and unitless numbers are treated as defects.
decision_log.basis: Process discipline: 'every numeric column carries its unit in its label'
